Package hadur2.core.memory

Class ProfileFolder

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.memory.ProfileFolder
public final class ProfileFolder extends Object
Collects one round's observations of the opponent and folds them into its profile when the round ends (MEM-2). The core reports what it sees as it sees it; nothing reaches the profile until fold(boolean), so the profile always holds whole rounds.

Distances are those at the moment of the observation: a shot is filed under the distance when it was fired or detected, a hit under the distance its wave was fired from when that is known.

HadurCore makes one folder per battle, at the first scan, around the profile the library loaded, and reports what it sees of the duel opponent as it sees it. The virtual-gun and normalised counts arrive differently from the rest: the gun and the surf keep battle totals, so the core hands the folder those totals just before fold(boolean) and the folder adds only what they grew by since the previous fold.

Every per-round buffer is bounded (RES-2): the counts are fixed-size arrays and the seed buffers keep only the latest OpponentProfile.MAX_GUN_SEED and OpponentProfile.MAX_SURF_SEED samples. Non-finite damage and lateral velocity are read as 0, so one bad input cannot poison a profile that lasts many battles.

    • leadAware

      public void leadAware(boolean standing)
      ADAPT-5: the lead-aware power rule's verdict as the round ends: whether POW-7's hit-rate condition stands. The core hands it over just before fold(boolean); the profile keeps the latest one, so after a battle's last round it holds the battle's end.
      Parameters:
      standing - whether the condition stands

    • shielder

      public void shielder(boolean treated)
      SHIELD-3: whether the enemy is treated as a bullet shielder as the round ends. The core hands it over just before fold(boolean); like the lead-aware verdict, the profile keeps the latest one.
      Parameters:
      treated - whether the enemy is treated as a shielder

    • fold

      public void fold(boolean won)
      MEM-2: adds this round to the profile and starts the next one.

      The core calls this once per round, at its end, after passing the battle totals to virtualGuns(double, double, double, double) and normalised(double, double). The profile then decays any count group past its limit (RES-2).

      Parameters:
      won - whether Hadur won the round
